method: Candidate pool: 38 well-known public TypeScript backends named by the operator (one name, goldbergyoni/practica, did not resolve; 37 probed) (GitHub search API not reachable from the run environment, so no query-based sampling); every candidate shallow-cloned without blobs to read its last commit, licence file and the number of non-test, non-declaration .ts files under each src/ directory. Inclusion, applied in this order: (1) OSI licence covering the analysed root; (2) last commit on or after 2024-01-01; (3) analysis root (one backend package) with 30-800 non-test .ts files under src/; (4) not in corpus/corpus.json (Study 1); (5) at most one analysis root per repository. Every candidate passing all five was kept (no random draw was needed: 14 passed, inside the 12-15 target). The two Study 1 projects listed under `rejected` were excluded by name and not probed. Pinned to the default-branch HEAD on 2026-10-15.
